MarketstackAPIKeyCredential.title: Marketstack API Key
MarketstackAPIKeyCredential.x-credential-instructions: Paste the API access key from your Marketstack dashboard. Data availability and intraday intervals depend on your plan. The connection read checks key acceptance, not account identity or access to every dataset.
